req.title: Set cookie via path
req.statement: The system shall set a cookie of name=<name>, value=<value> and redirect to /cookies when GET /cookies/set/<name>/<value> is called.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that GET /cookies/set/<name>/<value> sets a cookie and issues a 302 redirect to /cookies. Tests must verify: (1) positive path — correct 302 status, Set-Cookie header with exact name/value, Location header pointing to /cookies; (2) negative path — malformed or missing path segments; (3) boundary cases — single-character names/values, empty-string-like edge values, special characters. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes (302 not 301/303), exact Location header value, exact cookie name and value in Set-Cookie header, and verifying the redirect target is precisely /cookies.

tests.name: test_set_cookie_via_path_positive_standard
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
No pre-existing cookies in test client
trace: R-HTTPBIN-030: set cookie via path -> 302 redirect to /cookies with Set-Cookie
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_set_cookie_via_path_positive_standard():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/testname/testvalue', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location == '/cookies' or location.endswith('/cookies'), f'Location was {location!r}'
    set_cookie = r.headers.get('Set-Cookie', '')
    assert 'testname' in set_cookie, f'Set-Cookie missing name: {set_cookie!r}'
    assert 'testvalue' in set_cookie, f'Set-Cookie missing value: {set_cookie!r}'

test_set_cookie_via_path_positive_standard()

Verify cookie appears in JSON body

trace: R-HTTPBIN-030: redirect to /cookies which returns cookie data
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_set_cookie_via_path_follow_redirect_shows_cookie():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/session/abc123', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = json.loads(r.data)
    assert 'cookies' in data, f'No cookies key in response: {data}'
    assert data['cookies'].get('session') == 'abc123', f'Cookie value mismatch: {data["cookies"]}'

test_set_cookie_via_path_follow_redirect_shows_cookie()

actions: Verify each response sets the correct cookie name/value pair
expected: First response Set-Cookie contains cookie1=val1 not cookie2
Second response Set-Cookie contains cookie2=val2 not cookie1

tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_set_cookie_via_path_different_names_dont_collide():
    client = app.test_client()
    r1 = client.get('/cookies/set/cookie1/val1', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r1.status_code == 302
    sc1 = r1.headers.get('Set-Cookie', '')
    assert 'cookie1=val1' in sc1, f'Expected cookie1=val1 in {sc1!r}'
    assert 'cookie2' not in sc1, f'Unexpected cookie2 in {sc1!r}'

    r2 = client.get('/cookies/set/cookie2/val2', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r2.status_code == 302
    sc2 = r2.headers.get('Set-Cookie', '')
    assert 'cookie2=val2' in sc2, f'Expected cookie2=val2 in {sc2!r}'
    assert 'cookie1' not in sc2, f'Unexpected cookie1 in {sc2!r}'

test_set_cookie_via_path_different_names_dont_collide()
